-- READ-ONLY final invariant observation; compare with narrow preflight.
select current_timestamp as observed_at,
 (select count(*) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) as migration_count,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key',key,'value',value) order by key)
 from private.marketplace_config where key in ('dispatch_normal','dispatch_urgent','urgent_activation_policy')) as marketplace_config,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('policy',policy_key,'version',version,'role',beneficiary_role,
 'reason',activation_reason,'mode',charge_mode,'basis',unit_basis,'cost_rsd',platform_cost_rsd)
 order by policy_key,version) from private.connection_policy_versions) as connection_policy,
 jsonb_build_object(
 'publication_bundles',(select count(*) from private.publication_policy_bundles),
 'publication_decisions',(select count(*) from private.need_publication_decisions),
 'qa_questions',(select count(*) from private.preselection_qa_questions),
 'qa_answers',(select count(*) from private.preselection_qa_answer_versions),
 'qa_commands',(select count(*) from private.preselection_qa_commands),
 'profiles',(select count(*) from public.app_profiles),
 'needs',(select count(*) from public.needs),
 'responses',(select count(*) from public.marketplace_responses),
 'selections',(select count(*) from public.need_selections),
 'agreements',(select count(*) from public.agreements),
 'connection_activations',(select count(*) from private.connection_activations),
 'messages',(select count(*) from public.agreement_messages),
 'events',(select count(*) from public.user_activity_events),
 'deliveries',(select count(*) from public.notification_deliveries),
 'preferences',(select count(*) from public.notification_preferences),
 'devices',(select count(*) from public.notification_push_devices),
 'push_attempts',(select count(*) from public.notification_push_attempts),
 'fastest_needs',(select count(*) from public.needs where mode='FASTEST'),
 'autofill_selections',(select count(*) from public.need_selections where selection_mode='AUTO_FILL')
 ) as counts;
